lift_flax_module: lift a Flax nn.Module into a Haiku transformed function with a given name scope
transform_flax_with_state: transform a Flax nn.Module into a Haiku TransformedWithState instance for init and apply
convert_haiku_params_to_flax: convert Haiku parameters to a nested Flax collection using _from_haiku_params
convert_flax_to_haiku_state: convert a nested Flax collection to a Haiku state dict using _to_haiku_state
convert_haiku_state_to_flax: convert a Haiku state dict to a nested Flax collection using _from_haiku_state
